svg.title: Operand flow through a 4 × 4 output-stationary systolic array
svg.desc: The 16 processing elements with A rows entering from the left through i skew registers and B columns entering from the top through j skew registers; then clocks 1, 2, 3, 4 of a K = 2 tile, PE(i, j) multiplying A[i, k] by B[k, j] in clock k + i + j + 1 after tile_start.
svg.text: PE(i,j) keeps C[i,j] in its accumulator. The caller presents A[·,k] and B[k,·] unskewed in clock k + 1; the skew registers delay row i by i and column j by j clocks,
so A[i,k] and B[k,j] meet at PE(i,j) in clock k + i + j + 1 (clocks counted from tile_start = 0). Each PE forwards A to the right and B down.
skew register, A | B (row i has i, column j has j)
active PE: bold outline, does A[i,k]·B[k,j]
Below: a K = 2 tile. tile_done pulses in clock
K + ROWS + COLS − 1 = 9; the last MAC is in clock 8.
Clock 3 (operand clock 2): 5 MACs, no new input
Clock 4 (operand clock 3): 7 MACs, no new input
